### Oʻahu cubing returns with a mini competition!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.

##### We will also be holding Team Blind for the first time! Please check the [Team Blind tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AieaLiiOkakopa2025#63062-team-blind) for more information!
